name: dsh-xwide-annotation

addedFeatures: 配色工作室：小圆钮选色 / 4 套荧光预设 / 自定义取色 / Alt+Shift+C 循环 / 位置记忆 / localStorage 持久化
批注大纲列表：列出当前对话全部批注、编号按序配色，点击跳转到原句并高亮
批注登记带行级锚点（seqKey + rowHead），大纲与气泡来源按原文去重，「一键清空全部」按会话隔离

author: X-WIDE <xiupk@sina.com.cn>
description: DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply. X-WIDE fork adds a color studio and an annotation outline.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check lib/index.js && node --check client.js

description.en: Select assistant text to annotate, press Enter to send the annotation block with your message; the reply answers each annotation by number. Includes a color studio and an annotation outline.
description.zh: 选中助手文字即可批注，回车把批注块随消息一起发出；回复按编号逐条对照。含配色工作室与批注大纲。

shortDescription.zh: 选区批注 + 批注大纲 + 配色工作室
